title: Use the exact stationary profile without claiming free averaging
statement: For N=A+C>=3,B>=4, the literal fast birth-death rates have b=cP and d(a+1)=(a+1)Q after factoring (B)_4. Every interior edge is positive and the finite endpoints are correct. The binomial-product sigma_N is exactly stationary. Normalized same-a shell ratios lie between (e^-648/16)(N+1)/(N+1-a) and e^648(N+1)/(N+1-a); shifted-a+1 ratios lie between (e^-648/32)(N+1)/(a+1) and 7e^648(N+1)/(a+1). Constants are independent of N,a,B, while endpoint factors are not bounded. Arbitrary radial/B multiplication cancels FAST flux only, leaving connectors.
